name: Ancestral Warrior Totem
description: Consume 3 Endurance Charges to Raise a Totem that conjures spirit warriors. Each warrior uses a socketed Mace Skill once, then disappears. Cannot use Channelling Skills or Skills with Cooldowns.

stats.text: Cannot have more than 10 Ancestral Warrior Totems active
Conjures a spirit warrior every 50% of socketed Attack time
Totem gains +0% to all Elemental Resistances
Totem gains +0% to Chaos Resistance
